headline: Grumpy Walrus sold another 55k FLOW 8:25-9:30 PM ET (~300k left), plus 1M SNEK (~2.6k ADA) and ~783k SOLADA (~1.36k ADA), and put ~6.5k ADA into ~5,147 ASCEND (~323.7k) and ~1k ADA into ~199k COCK; ~5.26k ADA also came in from an outside wallet. Three swarm launches, all Pass: HALLOW (17 coordinated buyers, 4 fresh wallets), PATRICK (10 coordinated buyers incl., plus a first-block sniper) and LAMPS. COCK side ~151.7k, just back over its 150k line; ASCEND ~1.129M, STRIKE ~1.199M, FLOW ~639k. No open tickets; nothing passes k/y.
learned: Lessons: the prefilter missed the SOLADA sell and the COCK buy, so the full trace still matters on every whale_move wake.
